objects.function:brainia_block_deleted_embedding:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brainia_block_deleted_embedding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if (
    (new.object_type = 'event' and exists (
      select 1 from deletion_tombstones tombstone
      where tombstone.target_type = 'event' and tombstone.target_id = new.object_id
        and (new.owner_id is null or tombstone.owner_id = new.owner_id or tombstone.owner_id = new.client_id)
    ))
    or (new.object_type = 'entity' and exists (
      select 1 from event_entities link
      join deletion_tombstones tombstone
        on tombstone.target_type = 'event' and tombstone.target_id = link.event_id
      where link.entity_id = new.object_id
        and (new.owner_id is null or tombstone.owner_id = new.owner_id or tombstone.owner_id = new.client_id)
    ))
    or (new.object_type = 'fact' and exists (
      select 1 from knowledge_facts fact
      join deletion_tombstones tombstone
        on tombstone.target_type = 'event' and tombstone.target_id = fact.event_id
      where fact.id = new.object_id
        and (new.owner_id is null or tombstone.owner_id = coalesce(fact.owner_id, fact.client_id))
    ))
    or (new.object_type in ('insight', 'digest') and exists (
      select 1 from deletion_tombstones tombstone
      where tombstone.target_type = new.object_type and tombstone.target_id = new.object_id
        and (new.owner_id is null or tombstone.owner_id = new.owner_id)
    ))
  ) then
    if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
      return null;
    end if;
    -- Existing rows must remain updatable so quarantine/cleanup can mark or
    -- delete them; an update can never make a tombstoned embedding eligible.
    new.metadata := coalesce(new.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      || '{"deleted":true,"policyStale":true}'::jsonb;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
objects.function:brainia_bump_source_policy_vers:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brainia_bump_source_policy_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  if new.enabled is distinct from old.enabled
    or new.send_to_llm is distinct from old.send_to_llm
    or new.redact_emails is distinct from old.redact_emails
    or new.redact_financial_identifiers is distinct from old.redact_financial_identifiers
    or new.retention_days is distinct from old.retention_days
    or new.owner_id is distinct from old.owner_id
    or new.external_models_allowed is distinct from old.external_models_allowed
    or new.external_embeddings_allowed is distinct from old.external_embeddings_allowed then
    new.policy_version := coalesce(old.policy_version, 0) + 1;
  else
    new.policy_version := coalesce(old.policy_version, 1);
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

objects.function:brainia_v2_revision_immutable():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brainia_v2_revision_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE'
    and current_setting('brainia.v2_privacy_cleanup', true) = 'on'
    and current_user = pg_get_userbyid((select relowner from pg_class where oid = tg_relid)) then
    return old;
  end if;
  raise exception 'v2_revision_immutable' using errcode = '55000';
end;
$function$
objects.function:brainia_v2_row_visible(p_table:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brainia_v2_row_visible(p_table text, p_id text, p_owner text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select p_owner = public.brainia_current_owner()
    and p_table in ('raw_events','financial_transactions','knowledge_facts')
    and not exists(select 1 from public.owner_quarantine q
      where q.table_name=p_table and q.row_id=p_id and q.status='quarantined')
$function$
objects.function:enforce_entity_owner_visibility:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_entity_owner_visibility()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  if new.owner_id is null and coalesce(new.visibility, 'private') = 'private'
     and new.type not in ('domain', 'concept') then
    new.owner_id := null; -- unresolved legacy rows are quarantined by backfill
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
objects.function:invalidate_intelligence_finance:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invalidate_intelligence_finance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  update intelligence_artifacts set status='stale',updated_at=now() where status in ('ready','insufficient','running')
    and id in(select artifact_id from intelligence_dependencies where event_id=coalesce(NEW.anchor_event_id,OLD.anchor_event_id));
  return coalesce(NEW,OLD);
end $function$

begin
  update intelligence_artifacts set status='stale',updated_at=now()

  return coalesce(NEW,OLD);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_knowledge_pages_stale()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 update intelligence_artifacts set status='stale',updated_at=now() where kind='page' and saved
   and client_id is not distinct from NEW.client_id and status in ('ready','insufficient');
 return NEW;
end $function$
objects.function:next_sequence_value(sequence_na:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_sequence_value(sequence_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  next_value bigint;
begin
  update entity_sequences
  set value = value + 1
  where name = sequence_name
  returning value into next_value;

  return sequence_name || '_' || next_value::text;
end;
$function$
